item.title: They Won. He Accepted.
item.description: Champion ducks win the cup, while Donald turns their victory photo into his own acceptance pose. Political satire based on public reporting. Dialogue attributed to Donald is invented. Sources: The White House: https://www.whitehouse.gov/videos/president-trump-participates-in-a-fifa-world-cup-trophy-ceremony/ The Washington Post: https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2026/07/19/trump-loomed-over-world-cup-up-until-awkward-trophy-ceremony/ Los Angeles Times: https://www.latimes.com/sports/soccer/story/2026-07-20/trump-world-cup-trophy-spain-fifa-infantino-rodri
